identity.source_key_role: inherited O1 consumer context; its aggregate hash is not the body-6 payload hash
identity.body6_export_key_role: independent payload identity; do not overwrite or reinterpret source_key
identity.regularization: mu*I belongs outside the six-body sum
identity.domain_boundary: a cell-only or q=0 theorem cannot discharge the current global h_body_6

source_semantics.parent_axis_rule: z_j is read before DH step j; origins have slots 0..6
source_semantics.emission_point: body_trace_sink(6,row,col,body_term) after forming the i=5 body_term and before M[row][col] += body_term
forbidden_provenance: aggregate minus other bodies without separately justified source identities
Float64 samples or fitted coefficients substituted for exact atoms
source_semantics.local_replay_boundary: replaying the pinned artifact-local Python sink establishes its coefficient provenance only; neither deployed Julia nor Lean source equality follows

canonical_csv.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; LF; final newline; comma delimiter; unquoted integer fields
canonical_csv.integer_encoding: base-10 minimal spelling; no plus sign, no leading zeros, zero is 0
canonical_csv.matrix_indices: one-based integers 1..6; Lean conversion subtracts one exactly once
canonical_csv.frequency: signed integers nu1..nu6, paired with q0..q5 respectively
canonical_csv.coefficient: real and imaginary reduced rationals with positive denominators; zero is 0/1
canonical_csv.duplicate_policy: exporter sums exact duplicate atoms before serialization; intake rejects duplicate keys
canonical_csv.zero_policy: omit exactly zero Gaussian coefficients; absent keys and absent matrix entries mean exact zero
canonical_csv.support_policy: cover all 36 entries including empty entries; no thresholding, frequency clipping, or inferred zero complement
canonical_csv.evaluator: sum over matching rows of (real_num/real_den)*cos(sum_k nu_k*q_k) - (imag_num/imag_den)*sin(sum_k nu_k*q_k)
canonical_csv.signed_frequency_policy: retain full positive and negative frequency representation; no extra factor 2
canonical_csv.count_boundary: 610 rows and 32 nonempty entries describe this snapshot only; equal support or row counts with the aggregate are not semantic rejection criteria

required_now: exact source_key, state_key and independent body6_export_key
reference to this hashed contract for indexing, regularization and domain
canonical payload path, SHA-256, row count and nonempty/empty entry coverage
hashes of source snapshot, pre-accumulation sink and audit script
same-run replay result for the selected body against existing CSV
state revision/hash/node status as read-only observation, not a state update
source/evaluator/target file hashes and explicit absent proof receipts
false source-binding, h_body_6, comparator, registry and formal-certificate flags
required_for_future_theorem_use: canonical CSV to generated typed row-list reification evidence, including Lean file hash
exact statement and proof of sourceBodyMass q 5 = canonical evaluator for every q,i,j
exact statement and proof connecting canonical evaluator to the existing bodyTraceEvaluator 5, if that consumer is retained
pinned toolchain/Mathlib/import-closure hashes, compilation result and axiom report
same-key downstream comparator receipt when comparator admission is requested
minimum_receipt.missing_evidence: pending; null proof fields cannot count as supplied premises
minimum_receipt.mismatched_present_evidence: rejected: wrong body, source/state key, hash, coefficient, q-domain, regularizer, sign convention, or index mapping
minimum_receipt.admission_rule: data checks and receipt presence never prove a theorem or promote a registry

downstream_targets.G2: Body6GramFourierTarget rows with all 36 entries and a reified canonical row list
downstream_targets.canonical_source: G1 and G2 imply Body6CanonicalSourceTarget rows by equality transitivity
downstream_targets.G3: Body6LegacyTraceTarget rows; equality of CSV coefficients is not this Lean proof
downstream_targets.legacy_consumer: canonical_source and G3 imply the unchanged adapter h_body_6; a differently named evaluator alone does not
downstream_targets.aggregate_boundary: h_body_6 alone does not supply h_body_all, h_aggregate, M_DD45 binding, or an O1 left-inverse witness
